name: claude-mods
description: A collection of small mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Compact one-line usage: current session and this week, each with percent, a bar and the reset time.

plugins.name: agents-panel
plugins.description: Side pane with the sessions, agents and subagents that are active or still have a warm prompt cache, each with what it did last; click a title to open it.

plugins.name: usage-report
plugins.description: Today's usage across every session on the machine: tokens, models, effort, tool calls ok and failed, retries, API errors, sessions and subagents. Open it with /report.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Picks the model and effort from the first prompt of a session and keeps them for the whole session; gives each subagent its own model and effort by the difficulty of its part.
